rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion assignment to himself to articulate the conference’s narrow Omnicare/Macquarie-compatible rule: liability only when the risk-factor’s hypothetical framing, in context, conveys a present-condition implication that is rendered misleading by contemporaneous known materialization. The dissent is most likely led by Thomas (possibly with Barrett writing separately) to argue that conditional “may” language lacks the requisite textual hook and that the majority effectively recreates a forbidden duty to update.
